newsitem.title: USA: Caldera posts loss, sees Q4 charges.
newsitem.headline: Caldera posts loss, sees Q4 charges.

text.p: Caldera Technologies Inc, a provider of water filtration products, said for the nine months ending September 30 it posted a net loss of $1.8 million and faces an uncertain future unless it is able to secure new financing.
As a result of a corporate restructuring announced on October 11, 1996, the company said it will experience significant one-time charges in the fourth quarter.
A year ago, it had a net loss of $1.6 million in the same year-ago period. Sales for the nine months were $582,000, down from $716,000 a year ago.

It said a $1 million borrowing limit under its credit line with Trilon Dominion Partners LLC was fully used as of July 8, though Trilon has indicated it will continue funding on a limited basis. If other financing sources are not found, Caldera said it is unlikely it will be able to continue its operations.
